summary: R7: `harness stop <run> --why "<text>"` writes the reason into STOP; `status: stop <text>` carries one too. stop_why() in lib/driver.sh (STOP's line first, then INBOX, cut at 200) makes the note, ended, end_reason and the services note `stopped by Michael: <why>`; prompts/retro.md shows {{END_REASON}}. summary.mjs and page.mjs no longer read the reason's words as keywords.
verified_how: full suite via check.sh: 349/349 (341 before) on the final tree; run 2b's 8 checks watched failing first (5/10 on a scratch copy of runs 2 and 2b), the page tone check failing on the old page.mjs; bash -n and node --check on every touched file; an Opus review of the diff (5 low findings, 4 fixed)

dead_ends.tried: a summary.json cause check on a run stopped after the initializer
dead_ends.why: no feature is blocked there, so it passes with or without the keyword fix; the page.mjs card check covers that instead

discoveries.text: New stub flags: STUB_CLI_STOP=-|<why> (the initializer runs harness stop [--why]) and STUB_PHONE_STOP=<why> (status: stop <why>; 1 keeps the bare line). Both are in the stub's header.

summary.mjs used to strip ended's date with / · \d{4}-.*$/, which cut any reason holding ' · 2026-'. It is now anchored to the full timestamp. Its cause keywords (usage limit, blocked) are matched on `stopped by Michael` alone.
Left alone: ${w:0:200} counts bytes in a non-UTF-8 locale, so a long non-ASCII reason may be split inside a character.
